title: KCP endeavor_promotion_start request (amendment A5 wire name; byom §16.3 table row 2)
description: Mutation (meta required; §11.2). Acquires the durable slot for a send and submits: the pair moves prepared|awaiting_principal → submitting and COMMITS before any byte leaves Kovee, so a crash mid-send is recoverable from byom's own signed fact rather than indistinguishable from 'never sent'. The stable semantic command bytes are unchanged; only the expiring per-attempt authentication envelope is fresh, so a resubmission rides the SAME byom idempotency domain and cannot form a second Endeavor. Resuming from byom_committed or linking finishes the ExternalLink instead of re-sending. Registry (governed_work_binding_v1): surface operator / human realm-owner principal only — never a service identity, session, assistant, or connector. Surface and actor kind are registry-enforced, not schema-expressible.

authentication_observation_ref.description: The FRESH human authentication observation this attempt proves. §16.3 requires a fresh authentication attempt per send: reusing the previous attempt's observation is refused, which is what makes an awaiting_principal resubmission a real re-authentication.

args.description: Which formation, and this attempt's fresh authentication.

commandMeta.description: Command.meta (§11.2). Required on every mutation; idempotency keys are scoped by authenticated actor, operation, and realm; expected_revision drives optimistic concurrency (mismatch is stale-revision).

ext.description: Extensions keyed by a reverse-domain namespace (§11.9); never interpreted as identity, authorization, budget, or policy.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

protocolVersion.description: Negotiated KCP major.minor version; the initial protocol version is "0.1" (§11).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent header value; excluded from the idempotency request digest (§11.2).
